Name: Cute kitties cat slimes retexture expanded
Author: hisameartwork
Description:
Tiger slime now Tigger from Whiny the Pooh inspired. 
How to install content patcher version: unzip folder, place it in Stardew Valley > Mods folder. Done!
Be sure to install all dependencies. 


Thank you to Kath40 for making the code for tigger and giant expansion.

[youtube]qqeNm-aTI_A[/youtube]


Thanks  Glymr for patching my mod and making it compatible with latest [CP]
*Additionally you can get SMAPI and the Content Patcher and CJB Item Spawner mods for easy of use as seen in my video:

[youtube]nCEmHfCzUPs[/youtube]

Info for newbies to modding:
This mod is a common zip archive as are the Nexus mod upload rules. You need to unzip Nexus mods files before putting them in your game. Use programs like 7z or winrar to unarchive the files you get from here on NexusMods.

The file is called green slime, but the slimes are multicolored since the base art is grey and a overlay color is applied. Faces may not show well in black slimes. Slimes were not designed with mouths, I added mouths so sometimes they go outside the bound. 

This is a purely cosmetic mod as stated above. This does not change their behavior, sorry, but I'm not a programmer, I'm just an artists. I do what I can. 

Thank you for understanding.
